correctness.rationale: Cactus incidence kernels decompose as independent single-cycle null directions, giving direct-sum of bridge intervals and cyclic zonotopes, so uniform volume factors under constant-Jacobian addition. For each length-k cycle, acyclic orientations are all 2^k sign vectors except two constant-sign vectors, yielding C_v factor 2^(k-1)/(4(2^(k-1)-1)); equal-volume omitted-coordinate parallelepiped tiles yield C_a factor (k+2)/(12k). The ratios R3=12/5, R4=R5=16/7 and monotonic increase thereafter prove sharp Loewner and equality cases; bridge ratio=3. Matrix-tree theorem and spanning-tree product yield claimed pseudodeterminant ratio with positive rank n-1. Independently computed exact rational factors for k=3,4,5; finite checks only corroborate infinite cactus proof.
